US Army Plans Critical Minerals Processing Plants on Military Bases

The US Army is set to establish critical minerals processing plants on its military bases. This initiative aims to enhance the production of critical minerals. The move is expected to boost the overall output of these essential resources. The plants will be hosted within existing army facilities.
